blind.description: An interior wall section with an open doorway. The lower half features cream-colored paneled wainscoting, while the upper wall is covered in sage green wallpaper with a dark green damask pattern. The doorway is framed with molded beige/cream casing, and the top of the wall is capped with an overhanging matching crown molding cornice.
